edges: WASP - 44 was observed by the SuperWASP organization.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: The discovery of WASP - 44 and its planets was reported in a single discovery paper.
WASP - 44 has another known planet in its orbit named WASP - 44c.
WASP - 44 is the host star of the planet WASP - 44b.
The Leonhard Euler Telescope was used to follow up on the discovery of WASP - 44b.
